name: Supreme God of Army
overview:
Fifteen years ago, Leo Cohen's father started his business with the Family of Cruz, which made him the richest of Aracar City, after murdering Anthony Cohen ruthlessly for the sake of his personal interests, Carl Cruz threw young Leo Cohen off a cliff, who was luckily rescued by some mercenaries.

Fifteen years later, Leo Cohen returned to Aracar city for revenge. Soon he found his former lover Katherine Cruz was also there. They had a daughter named Emily Cohen. However, Katherine Cruz had in fact been abandoned by her father, Carl Cruz.

To crush Cruz family, Leo Cohen had to wed their daughter Cecilia Cruz and lived with them. He conspired with Katherine Cruz and set Cruz family up with a set of scheme. They managed to take back the business of Leo’s father in the end.
